Title: SIX
Description: From Tudor Queens to Pop Icons, the SIX wives of Henry VIII take the microphone to remix five hundred years of historical heartbreak into a Euphoric Celebration of 21st century girl power! This new original musical is the global sensation that everyone is losing their head over! The New York Times says SIX “TOTALLY RULES!” (Critic's Pick) and The Washington Post hails SIX as “Exactly the kind of energizing, inspirational illumination this town aches for!" The SIX: LIVE ON OPENING NIGHT Broadway album debuted at Number 1 on the Billboard cast album charts and surpassed one billion streams worldwide!

Title: SSP Presents: FrUiTCaKeS
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: ABOUT THE SHOW... Mix together a batch of fruitcakes, three dozen Christmas trees, 10,000 outdoor Christmas lights, a chicken pox epidemic, two southern spinsters, an estranged old man, a lost cat named Tutti Frutti and a Christmas hog named Buster and you've got the recipe for a fun-filled and touching evening of holiday cheer. Into this world comes Jamie, a kid who has run away from home and come as far as his money will take him. At first, he thinks this town's inhabitants are "nuttier than fruitcakes," but soon he comes to admire, appreciate and adore this nutty little town. A moving story of alienation, understanding and reconciliation, FrUiTCaKeS provides audiences with a heaping helping of holiday warmth and Christmas cheer. (Presented by arrangement with Dramatic Publishing.)

Title: Color Mixing with Transparent Watercolor
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Categories: Art Centers; Classes; Lectures & Workshops; Visual Arts
Description: Color mixing using transparent watercolor. Participants will create sunset silhouette paintings. Explore the magic of watercolor in this 3-hour workshop, suitable for beginners as well as experienced painters. First half: Participants will learn about (or review) the color wheel. Each participant will mix the full color spectrum using the 3 primary colors. Rest of session: Focus on the “wet on wet” technique of color mixing. Participants will create several sunset-colored skies using “lifting” techniques. These colored skies will later be used as the background for finished silhouette paintings. All materials provided. Each participant will also receive a mat for displaying one of the finished paintings. Information sheets and supply lists will be available for those who might want to further explore this fascinating medium.

Description: Scott Keo, a southern California native, is a veteran of the music industry as both a premier Michael Bublé tribute act and an experienced wedding DJ. Over the past 15 years, Scott Keo has become known for his distinctive voice and entertaining performances. He has performed at thousands of weddings and special events throughout the U.S. Scott recorded and released his original song, “All To You” in 2010, which has sold over 14,000 copies to date and has acquired over 750,000 views on YouTube. Additionally, it has become extremely popular in the wedding world and was listed as a “Groom-Mother Dance” song by Wedding Wire, a popular wedding website. “I remember hearing Michael Bublé’s song “Home” and just being overwhelmed with the emotion he evokes with the lyrics and the tone of his voice,” Scott said. “I started using more Bublé songs in my wedding sets and becoming a bigger fan which let me to experiment with my own performance of his songs.” In 2011, Scott began his Michael Bublé Tribute Act impressing audiences everywhere with his unbelievable accuracy, energy and crowd involvement. As both a solo act and a tribute performer, Keo has had the pleasure of sharing the stage with Bob Caudle, Terry Davies, Dave Halstrom, Mike Martis, Peter Petty and Steve Roman. Title: ELF THE MUSICAL
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: A title known the world over, Elf The Musical is a must-produce holiday musical that can easily become an annual tradition for any theatre. Based on the cherished 2003 New Line Cinema hit, Elf features songs by Tony Award nominees Matthew Sklar (The Prom, The Wedding Singer) and Chad Beguelin (Disney’s Aladdin on Broadway), with a book by Tony Award winners, Thomas Meehan (Annie, The Producers, Hairspray) and Bob Martin (The Drowsy Chaperone). Buddy, a young orphan, mistakenly crawls into Santa’s bag of gifts and is transported to the North Pole. The would-be elf is raised, unaware that he is actually a human until his enormous size and poor toy-making abilities cause him to face the truth. With Santa’s permission, Buddy embarks on a journey to New York City to find his birth father and discover his true identity. Faced with the harsh realities that his father is on the naughty list and his half-brother doesn’t even believe in Santa, Buddy is determined to win over his new family and help New York remember the true meaning of Christmas. This modern-day holiday classic is sure to make everyone embrace their inner elf. After all, the best way to spread Christmas Cheer is singing loud for all to hear. Elf The Musical is presented through special arrangement with Musical Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com

Title: Branden & James with Effie Passero presents "Cellovoci"
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: BRANDEN & JAMES bring the soulful timbre of James on his cello combined with Branden’s emotional and powerful vocals, creating a sound that leaves audiences feeling moved and inspired. They have “become a brand-name in the classical-crossover music world alongside the likes of Josh Groban, The Piano Guys, and Jackie Evancho”. The Bay Area Reporter “Hardly a supporting player, but, rather, a true co-creator and co-star” (Robert Windeler, NY Times Music Correspondent) Australian cellist James, began creating arrangements of familiar tunes that make you listen as you’ve never heard them before. Branden, a former finalist on America’s Got Talent & resident tenor at The Metropolitan Opera, Lyric Opera of Chicago, and Los Angeles Opera; recently penned a memoir entitled, Lyrics of My Life which entered Amazon Books new releases at #9. It was published by Simon & Schuster in September, 2020. Since forming a duo, they’ve been touring around the world with their innovative, classically inspired pop songs, and their undeniable charm and wit. In 2021-2022, they will launch a 60-city US tour called The Chasing Dreams Tour to promote their recently released debut album aptly named Chasing Dreams. Shortly after its release, BRANDEN & JAMES were named best unsigned artists in North America by Music Connection magazine. In 2021, BRANDEN & JAMES released their first Christmas Album, “A Christmas Gift” which they recently recorded in Mexico.

Title: Narnia
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Categories: Musical; Kids & Family Friendly; Theater & Performance
Description: Step through the wardrobe and into a world where snow never stops falling, a lion's roar can shake the sky, and four ordinary children become the heroes of an extraordinary kingdom. The first and most famous story of The Chronicles of Narnia has become a musical presentation of this unique, enchanted world filled with creatures and spirits of myth and fable, both good and evil, demonic and transcendent. The principal inhabitants, however, are the intelligent talking animals ruled by the majestic King Aslan, the great lion of Narnia. Though Aslan is often absent from the land (so that his very existence is doubted by some), he returns when the need for him is greatest. And entering Narnia at a moment of high adventure are some children — plucked from our world in unexpected ways to help Narnia and to learn from their Narnia odyssey lessons of courage, unselfishness, and wisdom that will help them grow. Narnia wants to sing, and from the excitement of the opening song, “Aslan’s on the Move”, to the joy of “Narnia” (You Can’t Imagine)”, your spirits will soar with all those in Narnia. Title: Trouble In Mind
Timezone: America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York
Description: written by Alice Childress directed by Dominic Santos Written in 1955, Trouble in Mind follows the rehearsal process of an anti-lynching play preparing for it’s Broadway debut. When Wiletta Mayer, a Black actress and stage veteran, challenges the play’s stereotypical portrayal of the Black characters, unsettling biases are unearthed. Empowering, satirical, and ahead of its time, Trouble in Mind is set to make CSP history with this not to be missed production. Content Advisory : Trouble in mind contains strong language (including racial slurs), themes of racism/discrimination, and mature subject matter, including smoking.

Title: Keeping a Visual Diary - 3 hour workshop
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: A blend of art-journaling and memory-keeping to inspire you to document your life in creative new ways This three-hour workshop invites participants into an immersive and approachable creative practice-keeping a visual diary. The session offers a "no-rules" philosophy that blends scrapbooking, bullet journaling, vision boarding, and mixed-media collage into a deeply personal, intuitive experience. Rather than focusing on perfection or planning, participants will be guided to embrace a mindful and spontaneous approach to self-expression. The workshop is designed to be inclusive and beginner-friendly, welcoming everyone from curious newcomers (even those who don't consider themselves artistic) to seasoned creatives looking for fresh inspiration. You’ll leave with your journal’s cover lovingly decorated, pages in progress, and supplies to keep your creativity flowing long after the workshop.

Title: Collections & Research Tours: Behind the Scenes
Description: @ Step beyond the galleries and into the museum’s Collections & Research department, where millions of years of natural history are carefully preserved, studied, and brought to life. Hosted by Robbie Mueller, Director of Interpretation and Exhibits Management, these small-group tours offer rare access to an area of the museum normally closed to the public. You’ll discover how shells, fossils, birds, and other remarkable objects help scientists track environmental change, uncover new discoveries, and answer questions about our world. It’s an insider experience revealing the hidden heart of the museum and just how fascinating, beautiful, and unexpectedly cool natural history collections can be. Pre-registration requested; walk-ins accepted if space allows. Program is recommended for ages 8+. Children ages 6 and up only please! $10 for DelMNS members/$30.50 for non-members (includes general admission to the museum for the entire day!). Title: CARTOON CHRISTMAS TRIO
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Journey into the timeless magic of Christmas with the Cartoon Christmas Trio at the Milton Theatre! Rediscover the heartwarming melodies from the Peanuts Christmas Cartoon as they come to life, note-for-note, with the original Guaraldi instrumentation. Join us for an enchanting evening filled with holiday spirit, harmonies, and the exceptional talent of the Milton Theatre’s Musical Theatre Ensemble. The Cartoon Christmas Trio celebrates 25 years as the original interpreter of classic holiday cartoon jazz! The trio was started in 1995 by bassist Rob Swanson for the sole purpose of playing music from classic Christmas cartoons, especially the music of Vince Guaraldi, the composer of the “Peanuts” soundtracks. Since it’s inception, the trio has played hundreds of shows including live appearances on NBC, ABC, Fox, and NPR. The trio was also honored to perform in Philadelphia’s premiere music venue, The Kimmel Center. The music of Vince Guaraldi, in particular the soundtrack of the Peanuts Christmas Cartoon, has become one of the best selling Christmas recordings of all time. The trio performs every song from this recording, using the exact instrumentation that Guaraldi originally composed for. In addition to the Peanuts music, the trio plays songs from “The Grinch Who Stole Christmas”, “Rudolph the Red Nose Reindeer”, “Frosty the Snowman”, and “The Little Drummer Boy”, just to name a few. Featuring: Jeff Knoettner, a product of the Berklee College of Music, is a pianist, composer, and teacher. Philadelphia based drummer Jimmy Coleman has worked with artists of such musical styles as R&B, Jazz, Funk, Pop and Electronica. www.jimmycoleman.com Playing bass for over 40 years, Rob Swanson has made a name for himself as one of the most versatile working bassists in the Philly metro area. Tripling on Electric, Upright, and Vocals, Rob finds himself in up to 20 different musical configurations on any given month, ranging from straight ahead bebop, groove, world, funk, and rock. www.robswansonmusic.com

Description: Bring in cherished objects and learn how to preserve them for future generations. From family quilts and photo albums to ceramics, portraits, furniture, and everything in between, conservation staff and students will hear the stories of your objects and share condition assessments, treatment recommendations, and display and storage advice. Your advance registration allows us to match you with someone who specializes in conservation of your object, whether it is a painting, textile, works of art on paper, book, archival document, photograph, furniture, or three-dimensional object (glass, ceramics, metals, organics). Free. By appointment only. Call 800.448.3883, x7029 to make an appointment. Limit three objects of the same media per 30-minute appointment. No monetary appraisals given. Conservation Clinics are also offered on March 4 and April 1, 2027 . Photo by Evan Krape

Title: The Old State House Concert Series – Stone Jack Ballers
Categories: Country / Folk / Bluegrass; Free; Kids & Family Friendly
Description: On Friday, December 11, Delaware Friends of Folk will present the next event in their 2026-27 Old State House concert series, inside the Old State House on The Green in Dover. This is the thirteenth season in the series which is produced in cooperation with the Delaware Division of Historical and Cultural Affairs and First State National Heritage Park and is supported by a generous grant from the Kent County Fund for the Arts. The one-hour performance will begin at 7:30 pm. The concert is free and open to the public. Doors open at 7:00 and seating is limited. The featured act is regional jam-band Stone Jack Ballers (SJB). The band is a three-(or more) piece that features the talents of local musicians Brian McDaniel on guitar and vocals, Geoff Frazier on percussion and backing vocals, and a rotating roster of extremely talented musicians that keep songs fresh and on your toes with new and surprising improvs mixed into their well-known repertoire. They love to turn classic rock songs into something new, yet true and recognizable. Their original music has the feel of something old with a touch of something new. One fan said, “It’s music from the heart that hits you right between the eyes.” Hailing from central Delaware, SJB are heavily influenced by Grateful Dead, The Allman Brothers, The Band, and other similar acts. They have grown to be a local favorite on the jam band circuit over the past 12 years, having performed shows on a weekly basis in venues of all shapes and sizes, SJB bring a blend of unique instrumentation, musical knowledge, and musical experiences together to achieve a harmonious, unique and pleasurable sound. The Old State House concert series is presented by Delaware Friends of Folk. These events are supported by a grant from the Kent County Fund for the Arts, an organization that aims to enhance the quality of life, educate, and broaden perspectives by supporting the arts and arts organizations in Kent County. Support is also provided by the First State National Heritage Park, a partnership of State and City agencies under the leadership of Delaware State Parks and the Delaware Division of Historical and Cultural Affairs. Delaware Friends of Folk are partially supported by a grant from the Delaware Division of the Arts, a state agency, in partnership with the National Endowment for the Arts. The Division promotes Delaware arts events on www.DelawareScene.com. Links: www.delfolk.org https://www.delfolk.org/state-house https://www.facebook.com/AllThingsJammable/

Title: Ted Vigil's Rocky Mountain Christmas: A Tribute to John Denver
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Ted Vigil is a singer, songwriter and a tribute artist. He was born in Seattle and raised in the Olympia area. He has been performing from the age of ten throughout school in concert, symphonic and jazz bands developing his talents as a drummer and singer. In 2006 Ted Vigil went on to Laughlin, NV to compete in the Talent Quest 2006 involving 28 states, New Zealand, Australia and Canada taking first place. He then went on to win KOMO TV 4’s NW Afternoon Celebrity Look Alike contest in Seattle. Ted now performs nationwide for all kinds of venues and events. He has wowed the crowd selling out theatres in Pennsylvania and Kansas and has played twice now for John Denvers own “Windstar Foundation” in Aspen, CO. Last year Ted was awarded the Rising Legend Award by the National Traditional Country Music Association. Ted also performed with Steve Wiesberg, John Denver's lead guitar player from the 70’s. The most heard comments after a show are “I can’t believe how much he looks and sounds like John Denver! It really took us back!”

Title: Winter Solstice Wreath-Making Workshop
Description: Embrace the quiet beauty of the season and celebrate the return of the light. In this workshop, you will craft a minimalist, Scandinavian-inspired Solstice wreath designed to bring natural warmth and modern elegance to your home. Instead of the traditional, over-stuffed holiday wreath, we will focus on texture, asymmetry, and restraint. You will work with a curated selection of fresh, long-lasting greenery—like airy cedar, fragrant pine, and structural juniper—leaving portions of the natural wreath form exposed. Accent your creation with understated, foraged elements like dried seed pods, delicate cones, and a simple linen ribbon for a timeless, organic finish. Hand pruners and garden gloves provided, but feel free to bring your own. This program takes place in-person at Mt. Title: Duke Ellington’s The Nutcracker Suite by Delmarva Big Band
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: The Nutcracker Suite is an album by American pianist, composer and bandleader Duke Ellington recorded for the Columbia label in 1960 featuring jazz interpretations of “The Nutcracker” by Tchaikovsky, arranged by Ellington and Billy Strayhorn. Four trumpets, four trombones, five saxophones, and a full rhythm section of piano, bass, guitar, drums, and a vocalist. 18 pieces on stage! Witness the harmonious interplay of brass and woodwinds, the melodious dance of the saxophones, and the breathtaking solos that will leave you in awe. Experience the magic of 18 passionate musicians coming together, pouring their hearts and souls into each note, captivating your senses and transporting you to a world of musical euphoria.

Title: Chesapeake Silver Cornet Brass Band Holiday Concert
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Enjoy your favorite holiday music in the style of the historic British Brass Bands by Delaware’s ONLY 35 piece all-brass concert band! Steeped in the grand tradition of offering a captivating blend of light classics, marches, swing, big band, and blues! Formed in 1996, the Chesapeake Silver Cornet Brass Band is comprised of amateur and professional musicians from New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Maryland, and Delaware. Following the brass banding tradition, we are an all-volunteer organization. The band performs a varied repertoire of contemporary and traditional brass band music throughout the Mid-Atlantic region. The Chesapeake Brass Band is Delaware’s only 35 piece all-brass concert band developed in the tradition of British Brass Bands formed during England’s industrial revolution of the late 1800’s. Performances feature light classics, marches, big band, swing and blues with a narrative to add humor and educational value to the concert.

Title: Twelve Twenty Four – A Holiday Rock Concert – MATINEE
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Experience the magic of the holidays like never before with Twelve Twenty-Four, the nation’s original and longest-running tribute to the Trans-Siberian Orchestra. This high-energy rock orchestra features a dynamic six-piece band, a multi-piece string section, and powerhouse vocalists delivering an unforgettable seasonal spectacle. From intricate instrumentation to an electrifying light show, they bring the passion and grand theatricality of a holiday rock tradition straight to the stage. Twelve Twenty Four is a high-energy, full-scale, holiday rock orchestra concert featuring everyone’s favorite rock-edge holiday music as well as their own holiday creations. This dedicated group of performers work year-round to deliver a theatrical and memorable Christmas concert experience suitable for fans of all ages. “Create a resounding holiday rock orchestra,” that was the 2002 vision of Twelve Twenty-Four co-founders George Houseknecht, Richie Kossuth, Lenny Kucinski, and Jason Santos. A vision that was not only fulfilled, but one that energetically continues to this day. Since its inception, the band has evolved from a five-piece rock band to a complete rock orchestra. Inspired by the music and stage presentation of some of music’s greatest rock orchestras, Twelve Twenty-Four presents a show that involves high-energy rock music combined with professional stage effects. If it appears to be a considerable effort for a month and a half of shows, Music Director Jason Santos said there are good reasons the group tours each year. “The way people come back every year … it’s emotionally charging. It’s uplifting when people are talking and they say it starts their Christmas off or they’re having a bad day and needed some spiritual uplifting,” Santos said.

Title: A NOT-SO-SILENT NIGHT FEATURING MAMA’S BLACK SHEEP, REGINA SAYLES & COLLEEN CLARK – MATINEE
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Join us for “ A Not-So-Silent Night ”, a lively Holiday Themed Show with Mama’s Black Sheep, Regina Sayles, and Colleen Clark! The artists will be playing original songs along with Holiday Favorites to get you in the spirit of the season. This show has lots of sing-a-long opportunities, and is suitable for all ages from kids to Grandparents, making it a fun Holiday event for the whole family. Mama’s Black Sheep Mama’s Black Sheep is the soulful collaboration of singer-songwriters Ashland Miller(guitar/vocals) and Laura Cerulli (drums/vocals). Together, this duo creates a blend of hit worthy originals and covers with a unique spin. Each song allows you to travel with time, whether you’re swinging to Country, Rocking to Pop, Grooving to Soul, or swaying to the Blues; there’s always something to move your body and stir your soul! Mama’s Black Sheep has been making music and touring extensively for over 15 years. The duo has five well received albums, including their newest release “Fight Back With Love” (Oct.2024) Regina Sayles Based in East Stroudsburg, PA, Regina Sayles plays 100+ live shows a year and tours whenever possible. Regina typically plays solo but can also be found occasionally playing with her full band or a string quartet. She’s been a featured vocalist in the Craig Thatcher Band for the past 3 years and has recently joined forces with Mama’s Black Sheep playing bass and adding vocals. Regina plays her original music and a wide variety of covers spanning all genres. She has appeared on stage with folk pioneer Tret Fure, and feminist icon Ani DiFranco. In 2019 her former duo, Porter & Sayles, was a featured artist on the Melissa Etheridge Cruise, and had the opportunity to open for artists such as Pat Benetar, The Steve Miller Band, Frankie Ballard, and Dan+Shea. Colleen Clark Colleen Clark is a musician and audio engineer from Rehoboth Beach, DE. She has performed with Christine Havrilla & Gypsy Fuzz, Mama’s Black Sheep, Red Letter Day, the Zen Monkeys, Wicked Jezabel, and SONIA disappear fear and worked as producer and recording engineer on a variety of projects, including two full-length albums of her own music. Colleen also works as a freelance live sound engineer and serves as the front-of-house engineer at both the Virginia Women’s Music Festival and the National Women’s Music Festival in Middleton, WI. She is an Associate Professor in the Music Program at Salisbury University, where she teaches courses in audio production, live sound engineering, acoustics, and ear training.

In 2019 her former duo, Porter & Sayles, was a featured artist on the Melissa Etheridge Cruise, and had the opportunity to open for artists such as Pat Benetar, The Steve Miller Band, Frankie Ballard, and Dan+Shea. Colleen Clark Colleen Clark is a musician and audio engineer from Rehoboth Beach, DE. She has performed with Christine Havrilla & Gypsy Fuzz, Mama’s Black Sheep, Red Letter Day, the Zen Monkeys, Wicked Jezabel, and SONIA disappear fear and worked as producer and recording engineer on a variety of projects, including two full-length albums of her own music. Colleen also works as a freelance live sound engineer and serves as the front-of-house engineer at both the Virginia Women’s Music Festival and the National Women’s Music Festival in Middleton, WI. She is an Associate Professor in the Music Program at Salisbury University, where she teaches courses in audio production, live sound engineering, acoustics, and ear training.

Title: Elf The Musical
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Experience the magic of the holidays right in the heart of historic Milton! This season, the Milton Theatre brings the spirit of New York City to our stage with the hilarious and heartwarming production of ELF: The Musical. A title known the world over, Elf The Musical is a must-produce holiday musical that can easily become an annual tradition for any theatre. Based on the cherished 2003 New Line Cinema hit, Elf features songs by Tony Award nominees Matthew Sklar (The Prom, The Wedding Singer) and Chad Beguelin (Disney’s Aladdin on Broadway), with a book by Tony Award winners, Thomas Meehan (Annie, The Producers, Hairspray) and Bob Martin (The Drowsy Chaperone). Buddy, a young orphan, mistakenly crawls into Santa’s bag of gifts and is transported to the North Pole. The would-be elf is raised, unaware that he is actually a human until his enormous size and poor toy-making abilities cause him to face the truth. With Santa’s permission, Buddy embarks on a journey to New York City to find his birth father and discover his true identity. Faced with the harsh realities that his father is on the naughty list and his half-brother doesn’t even believe in Santa, Buddy is determined to win over his new family and help New York remember the true meaning of Christmas. This modern-day holiday classic is sure to make everyone embrace their inner elf. After all, the best way to spread Christmas Cheer is singing loud for all to hear. Elf The Musical is presented through special arrangement with Musical Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com

Title: Knee High Naturalists: Evergreens ~ Coverdale Farm Preserve
Description: Enjoy a winter stroll to learn all about evergreens and collect greenery for seasonal craft! Discover the wonders of nature with your little one! Enjoy hands-on nature discovery outdoors with our Teacher Naturalists. | $15.00 (ages 3-5)*

Title: SLAY BELLES: A HOLIDAY DRAG SHOW
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Get ready to sleigh the season with laughter, glamour, and a whole lot of holiday sparkle! Hosted by the fabulous Magnolia Applebottom, Slay Belles is the Milton Theatre’s most dazzling holiday tradition—serving up fierce performances, festive fun, and enough sass to light up your Christmas tree. So grab your besties, throw on your holiday sparkle, and join us for a night where the Belles slay, the drinks flow, and the holiday spirit shines brighter than ever! Magnolia Applebottom is a world class cabaret performer from Jackson, Mississippi. Mrs. Applebottom is a mid-life crisis at its finest. She’s kooky, she’s cool, she barley finished school but she knows how to put a smile on any face. So like her page and share her antics with your friends. Maybe go to a Magnolia Applebottom show!

Title: SINATRA’S CHRISTMAS WITH TONY SANDS
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Step into a world of elegance and nostalgia as Tony Sands channels the legendary Frank Sinatra, serenading you with the smoothest, most iconic hits from the Chairman of the Board himself. Backed by a talented FULL BAND – SWINGTOPIA that captures the essence of the Swing Era, this show will transport you to a bygone era of sophistication and class. Get ready for an unforgettable evening of unforgettable melodies and Sinatra’s signature style! VOTED #1 SINATRA VOCALIST IN THE COUNTRY ​Lifelong Sinatra fans are fascinated when they hear Tony Sands start to croon. They think ‘Ol Blue Eyes’ has come back to life! For more than 30 years, Tony Sands has been perfecting his act, and wooing audiences all over the United States. Sands caught the Sinatra bug as a child growing up in South Philly. “When I was 12 or 13 years old, that’s when I first wanted to sing,” Sands says. “My family played Sinatra records all the time, and I started singing along. The next thing I knew, I just fell in love with his music…and here I am.”

Title: The Unexpected Boys
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: In 2007, The Unexpected Boys™ opened their first show in for Diana Ross in Upper Saddle River, NJ. Nine years and seven continents later…yes even Antarctica…The Unexpected Boys have amazed audiences all over the world amassing over 2,500 performances. They have headlined at Yankee Stadium, The Pentagon, Formula One Singapore, Heinz Field, The Atlantis Hotel and Resort in Dubai, and theatres all over the U.S. They have opened for Diana Ross, Dionne Warwick, Deborah Cox, and Chubby Checker, President George W. Bush, and were also featured on the season finale of The Housewives of New York on The Bravo Network. This act is a musical tribute to Frankie Valli and The Four Seasons/Jersey Boys, featuring such unforgettable hits as Sherry, Walk Like a Man, Oh, What a Night, Big Girls Don’t Cry, and many more! We have also added a myriad of other styles to our repertoire including Beach Boys, Broadway, and a wide array of Opera classics! Michael Cerbelli was quoted as saying “As an entertainment producer, if they amaze me in five minutes, then I know the crowd will never forget them…I still get accolades from everyone I run into that know them! Accept no imitation…this is the best tribute act that I have ever seen!” Tickets $37 VIP | $33 Balcony | $28 General Admission Doors open 45 minutes prior to show *Does not include convenience or handling fees* No refunds or exchanges

Title: THE NAUGHTY LIST LIVE: STAND-UP COMEDY
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Tired of holiday cheer? Ready for some holiday jeer? Leave the kids at home and join us for a night of unapologetic, unfiltered comedy about the most stressful time of the year. Headliner: Ty Jamison Ty is a well traveled professional Stand up Comedian, adept to any crowd any situation energy high octane or smooth. Credits include Comic View, Apollo, and Comedy Clubs across the country. Feature: Eddie Gallagher Eddie Gallagher began performing stand-up comedy in July of 2011. While his first year on stage was filled with great experiences and opportunities to work alongside talented comedians, Eddie quickly realized that limited stage time for newer performers at many venues made it difficult to grow. In response, he began producing and booking his own comedy shows—creating opportunities not only for himself, but for up-and-coming comedians, while still featuring seasoned veterans. Over the years, Eddie has hosted and featured for nationally recognized comedians, including Jim Florentine, Don Jamieson, Rich Vos, Bonnie McFarlane, Kurt Metzger, Jay Oakerson, Mike Vecchione, and Bob Nelson. He was also scheduled to feature for Dom Irrera in March of 2020, a performance that was unfortunately canceled due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Under Eddie’s leadership, Kricket Comedy has been voted Best of Delco for Best Comedy Show seven consecutive years: 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025. Host: Keith Purnell Keith is one of the fastest rising comics from Delaware. He’s a high energy performer whose quick wit, style, and fast pace humor make him a hit and personal favorite of audiences young and old. He performs at Comedy Clubs across the country and has appeared on Television and in Movies. He was a winner in the Howard Stern “Kill or Be Killed” Comedy Competition and was the Philadelphia Regional winner in the Sierra Mist Next Great Comic Comedy Competition. Keith has had appearances on Last Comic Standing and is gaining a reputation as the next rising star.

Title: HOLIDAY TEA: INTERACTIVE LIVE SHOW
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Categories: Children's Theater; Kids & Family Friendly; Music
Description: Have Tea & Cookies with Your Favorite Holiday Characters! Join us for tea and live entertainment with your favorite holiday characters! PLUS! MEET SANTA! Your kids will love the chance to have tea and cookies with their favorite characters at this interactive show. Yes, we really will be serving tea! Join your favorite characters for this audience-interactive holiday show. Hot or cold tea served with fresh-baked cookie. Characters will sing, dance, and tell stories all while engaging the entire audience. An after show meet and greet will allow participants to snap a photo with their favorite characters. Featuring the kids from the Milton Theatre’s “Triple Threat” musical theatre program!

Title: MILTON’S MERRY MELODIES: A HOMETOWN HOLIDAY CABARET – MATINEE
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Join us at the Milton Theatre for a magical evening filled with warmth, nostalgia, and the joyous sounds of the season. Celebrate the holidays with cherished local performers as they light up the stage with their incredible talent, weaving together a tapestry of music and merriment that captures the essence of our beloved town. Come together as a community to embrace the festive cheer and create treasured memories that will resonate long after the final notes fade away. Throughout the show, you’ll be treated to a delightful mix of classic holiday songs and modern interpretations, performed by a talented ensemble of singers with voices that capture the spirit of the season. The music is bound to fill your heart with joy and nostalgia.

Title: BEARLY DEAD – A GRATEFUL DEAD TRIBUTE BAND
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Get ready for a full-throttle exploration of the jam band cosmos. > Bearly Dead has rapidly risen from a beloved New England underground staple to a premier national touring tribute act. Celebrated for their fresh, high-energy approach, the band digs deep into the extended Grateful Dead universe, covering any track ever performed by any member of the Dead, alongside unexpected sonic left turns like Talking Heads, Bob Dylan, and Phish! Not just another Grateful Dead cover band. A cosmic exploration of the Grateful Dead catalog! Bearly Dead, Boston-based quintet, performs a concert-style show that celebrates the journey of the Grateful Dead from their earliest records until their final tours. The band delivers a full-spectrum experience filled with danceable energy and world-class musicianship. Each and every Grateful Dead member is honored through a collection of classics, b-sides, deep cuts, and exploratory jams. Holding true to the spirit of the music, Bearly Dead frequently adds to their 250+ song catalog and continues to showcase authentic, spontaneous improvisation – live and in-person – making each show a wildly unique Grateful Dead experience you do not want to miss. Bearly Dead played their first show at Church of Boston, in 2015, marking the beginning of its hallowed Wednesday Night Residency. Over the next 5 years the phrase “Never Miss A Wednesday Show” became ubiquitous around Boston and Bearly Dead was nominated multiple times for Boston Music Awards Live Music Residency of the Year. Fans really never knew what might happen, the band never knew what might happen!

Title: IT’S A WONDERFUL LIFE (1946): FILM SCREENING – MATINEE
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Milton Theatre Art House Film Series Favorite Step into the enchanting world of holiday wonder as the Milton Theatre proudly presents the timeless classic, “It’s A Wonderful Life,” for an unforgettable movie screening that will warm your heart and leave you brimming with joy! Gather your loved ones and join us in celebrating the spirit of the season with this beloved masterpiece, which has charmed audiences for generations. The “Milton Theatre Art House Film Series” celebrates some of the very best award-winning films that you may not have heard of! This is the chance for film lovers to appreciate these great works in a physical space where cinema truly comes alive! Now, more than ever, the world needs thought-provoking, meaningful and life-changing art, and the venues in which to experience it. The Milton Theatre Art House Film Series acknowledges the vibrant and multifaceted independent film culture that exists outside of the mainstream cinema while simultaneously celebrating some of Hollywood’s greatest releases! George Bailey has so many problems he is thinking about ending it all – and it’s Christmas! As the angels discuss George, we see his life in flashback. As George is about to jump from a bridge, he ends up rescuing his guardian angel, Clarence – who then shows George what his town would have looked like if it hadn’t been for all his good deeds over the years.

Title: Star Lab programs
Description: @ Step inside Star Lab and journey through the cosmos without leaving Earth Star Lab programs are available as an add-on experience on Saturdays and Sundays at 10:30 a.m., 11:30 a.m. and 1:30 p.m. Tickets may be purchased at the museum’s front desk, or on the eSales calendar when purchasing advance admission. Prices below are in addition to general admission or membership. Purchase advance tickets for Star Lab on the eSales calendar Member Prices: Ages 3 & up $3, Toddler $1. Non-Member Pricing: Ages 3 & up $5, Toddler $2 . The Delaware Museum of Nature and Science’s immersive dome experience takes you on an unforgettable voyage through space. Inside this intimate, inflatable 360° planetarium, stunning visuals wrap around you as one of our expert Museum Educators guides you through the wonders of the universe. Each 30-45 minute program explores captivating astronomical or Earth science topics including our Solar System, the stories behind constellations, the lifecycle of stars, distant galaxies, and other cosmic phenomena. The dome’s enveloping projections create the sensation of floating through space, making complex scientific concepts accessible and exciting for visitors of all ages. More than just observation, Star Lab sparks curiosity and wonder, turning learning into…

Title: THE GAMBLER RETURNS: ULTIMATE KENNY ROGERS TRIBUTE
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Experience the music of GRAMMY® Award-winning superstar Kenny Rogers by Alan Turner. A musical experience that spans over six decades of hit after hit song! His music is loved throughout the world and connects with generation after generation. Kenny’s command of the stage, heartfelt performances, gift for storytelling and distinctive voice are all on full display in this honoring recreation of his LIVE performances. Join us as, award winning country recording artist Alan Turner, recreates the magic of a night with Kenny in the Ultimate Kenny Rogers Tribute Show, The Gambler Returns. This full band top production show will take you on a musical journey through the career of an American Icon and Legend that sold over 120 million albums worldwide and racked up some 24 No.1 hits (including “The Gambler,” “Lady,” “Islands In The Stream,” “Lucille,” “She Believes In Me” and so many more). Audiences leave the performance wanting more. Not since Garth Brooks jumped off the stage and into people’s hearts has the country scene delivered such riveting entertainment as southeastern Michigan’s Alan Turner and his Steel Horse Band. His connection with his fans makes him stand out, and his rugged good looks, rich baritone vocals and the way he delivers the song to his captivated audiences has set him above the rest. Alan’s love for music is visible in the way he can emotionally deliver each song and the story it tells on stage. For Alan that love came full circle in Las Vegas, Nevada in 2010 when he and the band had the honor of meeting Kenny and being his direct opening act. In the years that have followed he has broken onto radio and television everywhere with his well-written and crafted songs, Bull Riding Babe (2015), Preacher Man and Me (2016), Windows & Mirrors (2017) Tennessee Twister (2019), That’s Why They Make Beer! (2019), Let Go (2020) and his latest release Vintage(2021). All across the USA and into Canada, Alan and the band have been thrilling crowds with his distinctly high energy Renegade Country Music! With nonstop performance schedule of over 100 plus shows a year there is no sign of him slowing down! This is one cowboy ya don’t want to miss!

Title: FESTIVE FRENZY: THE DEVIL’S BRIGADE HOLIDAY SPECTACULAR (FORMERLY THE AMERICAN ROGUES)
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Join The Devil’s Brigade (formerly The American Rogues) on a thrilling musical journey as they infuse the holiday season with their signature energy and passion. “Festive Frenzy” brings together the magic of the holidays and the band’s electrifying performances, creating a one-of-a-kind holiday show that will leave audiences captivated and filled with the spirit of the season. Get ready for a spectacular celebration of music, merriment, and a touch of Celtic charm! THE DEVIL’S BRIGADE, formally known as the First Special Service Force, was a highly decorated Canadian/American commando unit in WWII. Their legendary heroism struck fear into the hearts of Nazis and their legacy can be traced directly to the Canadian Special Operations Regiment and Green Berets. The American Rogues have long supported Veterans and by becoming THE DEVIL’S BRIGADE we seek to not only honour those who serve but also reflect our own Canadian/American identity. Drawing favourable comparisons to Wolfstone, Afro Celt Sound System, and Trans-Siberian Orchestra and consistently providing performances from Grade 1 bagpipers and other world class musicians this high-energy Canadian/American group has electrified audiences on three continents for years. They have expanded their ever-growing family of fans at music festivals, theatres, military bases, weddings, memorial ceremonies, corporate events, and more. This has even included shows with world-renowned violinist/composers Lindsey Stirling and Alison Krauss, as well as airplay on TV and radio, and shows at non-Celtic venues such as the World Music Festival in Quebec where they have both kicked off and closed the 6 day event to widespread acclaim (they’ve been asked to play this festival 10 years in a row and counting).

Title: DUELING PIANOS WITH FLYING IVORIES – 2027 NEW YEAR’S EVE PARTY!
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Ring in the New Year with a World-Class Dueling Pianos Show at the historic Milton Theatre! 3 Hour Extravaganza! Enjoy live dueling pianos from 9:30pm-12:30am! Two performers on two pianos deliver an all-request, rock and roll sing-along! From Billy Joel to Aretha Franklin, from Sinatra to Metallica, from Johnny Cash to Katy Perry, we’ve got it covered. In the fall of 2001, Brad Alexander launched the first ever Dueling Piano show in NYC. Every Friday and Saturday night, in the basement of O’Flaherty’s Ale House on Manhattan’s Restaurant Row, Brad and a small group of piano players faced off on two Casio Celviano keyboards for a four-hour singalong with an audience that grew from 10 to far beyond legal capacity. From there the show moved through several incarnations and locales over the course of a decade, from Times Square to Virginia Beach, and eventually landed at Bar Nine in NYC, where Brad and fellow performer James Barr formed THE FLYING IVORIES. With a rotating roster of top performers from around the country, THE FLYING IVORIES deliver an all-request, rock and roll sing-along for weddings, fundraisers, company outings, holidays, birthdays, bachelorette parties, virtual events and more.

Title: ELO Tribute: Atomic Light Orchestra
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: ALO: Atomic Light Orchestra pays tribute to the music of ELO and The Traveling Wilburys with faithful, near record-like versions of all your favorite songs. Of course all the hits are here but so are the deep album tracks that you'll remember. You'll feel like you're back in your bedroom at your parent's house on the street where you grew up! Guaranteed to have you dancing and singing along, all night long. Reproducing the sound of ELO is a tough task. Just ask any musician. This band has the goods. Dennis Schocket's (guitars and lead vocals) voice is directly influenced by Jeff Lynne. "I think Jeff is quite possibly the greatest, most under rated pop vocalist ever." Gregg Simmons (lead guitar and lead vocals) is known for his great fret work but it's his incredible falsetto that gets him noticed here. Gregg says "You can't make ELO music without the high notes!" He's right of course. Veteran keyboardist, John Kelly (keys, guitar and lead vocals) takes on the multiple rolls of keys and strings with effortless grace and joy. John says "This music is just so beautifully crafted." Violinist Greta Thomas is the newest member of the band. She brings her classically trained excellence to every song. Multi-instrumentalist Bronson Wagner (bass, keys and lead vocals) has the difficult task of reproducing that epic ELO bass rumble, but does so with style and flair. Anchoring all this is drummer Phil Brotman, doing his best Bev Bevan impersonation. "I love this music. It's just full of joy and love."

Title: Ecological Landscape Design
Description: Ecologically sound landscape design integrates human action with natural processes and communicates a sense of place. This course introduces you to the principles and practices behind designing landscapes that respond to local environmental conditions, conserve resources, and support dynamic ecosystems. Through a combination of classroom learning and outdoor observation, you’ll learn how to assess, inventory, and analyze a site’s unique characteristics—from soils and hydrology to microclimates and existing vegetation. Building on this systematic process, you’ll develop a conceptual design and planting plan that prioritizes native species, ecological function, and long-term resilience. You’ll explore strategies for increasing biodiversity, reducing lawn areas, and creating habitat that supports insects, birds, and other wildlife. Expect to broaden your design perspective and gain practical tools for creating landscapes that are both aesthetically pleasing and environmentally responsible. Please dress for the weather, as portions of the class may take place outdoors. Click here to review the list of provided materials and those that you will need to bring to the class. It is recommended that students take Ecological Landscape Design at the end of the program due to the complexity of the course, and connection to content taught in other classes. This program takes place in-person…

Title: Knee High in the Kitchen, Jan 6 ~ Coverdale Farm Preserve
Description: Preschoolers and their grown-ups enjoy a hands-on cooking class using simple, fresh ingredients. Together they mix, measure, and taste, building early skills and confidence. Each session ends with a tasty snack they make side-by-side | $28.00 (ages 3-5)*

Title: THE MIDNIGHT ROCK SHOW – 70’S ROCK CONCERT EXPERIENCE!
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Put on your bellbottoms and get ready to rock! THE 1970s MIDNIGHT ROCK SHOW! An Unforgettable Tribute to the Golden Age of Arena Rock Step into a time machine and relive the most electrifying decade in music history with The 1970s Midnight Rock Show — an authentic, high-powered rock spectacle that pays tribute to the legendary era of arena rock. Every performance is a musical journey, capturing the sound, energy, and spectacle of the biggest concerts of the 1970s. No backing tracks. No gimmicks. Just pure rock ‘n’ roll — the way it was meant to be. THE SOUND. THE EXPERIENCE. THE SHOW. The 1970s Midnight Rock Show isn’t just a tribute band — it’s a time capsule. With meticulous attention to musical detail, vintage instruments, and a full laser light show, audiences are transported to a time when rock was larger than life. From the soaring vocals of Boston and the dual-guitar thunder of Thin Lizzy, to the theatrical flair of Queen and the epic arrangements of Pink Floyd — every note is live, loud, and true to the original sound. This show has been carefully constructed to deliver the immersive concert experience fans crave, making it a perfect fit for professional theaters, festivals, performing arts centers, casinos, corporate events, and large music venues across the U.S.

Title: CLUE
Description: A mansion. A murder. A mystery. Murder and blackmail are on the menu when six mysterious guests assemble at Boddy Manor for a night they’ll never forget! Was it Mrs. Peacock in the study with the knife? Or was it Colonel Mustard in the library with the wrench? Based on the fan-favorite 1985 Paramount Pictures movie and inspired by the classic Hasbro board game, Clue is the ultimate whodunit that will leave you dying of laughter and keep you guessing until the final twist.

Title: URGENT – FOREIGNER TRIBUTE BAND
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: “The Definitive Foreigner Tribute” band! Their electrifying performances capture the essence of the legendary band Foreigner delivering their iconic hits with precision and passion. Experience the songs you know including “Feels Like the First Time” “Cold As Ice” “Juke Box Hero” “I Want to Know What Love Is, “and many others in a hit packed show. The seasoned musicians of Urgent-Tribute to Foreigner bring Foreigner’s timeless music to life, ensuring an unforgettable experience for fans of all ages. Urgent is a six-piece powerhouse made up of seasoned veterans of the Pennsylvania music scene. The band delivers an authentic Foreigner experience, recreating the iconic sound, harmonies, and energy of one of the greatest rock bands of all time.

Title: F*CK NEW YEAR’S RESOLUTIONS: STAND-UP COMEDY SHOW!

Description: Kick off the year with bold punchlines! Start your year with a night of unapologetic laughter! Ditch the kale smoothies, forget the gym membership, and join us for a riotous evening that throws the pressure of perfection out the window. “F*ck New Year’s Resolutions” features a powerhouse trio of comedians who are done pretending they’re giving up carbs. Title: The Old State House Concert Series – Jessica Graae
Categories: Country / Folk / Bluegrass; Free; Kids & Family Friendly
Description: On Friday, January 8, 2027, Delaware Friends of Folk will present the next event in their 2026-27 Old State House concert series, inside the Old State House on The Green in Dover. This is the thirteenth season in the series which is produced in cooperation with the Delaware Division of Historical and Cultural Affairs and First State National Heritage Park and is supported by a generous grant from the Kent County Fund for the Arts. The one-hour performance will begin at 7:30 pm. The concert is free and open to the public. Doors open at 7:00 and seating is limited. The featured act is local singer-songwriter Jessica Graae. Jessica blends her folk-rock style and classical training to create haunting, soulful songs. Her “evocative, lush, exquisite” vocals are accompanied by “elegant and impressive guitar playing”. Twice named WSTW’s Hometown Hero's “Best Female Solo Artist”, Jessica has performed live on Joltin’ Joe’s Radio Nowhere, Gene Shay’s Folk Show (WXPN), Graffiti Radio, WCHE’s SoundStage and WSTW’s Hometown Heroes. She has been featured at the Haverford Music Festival, the Ladybug Festival and the Delmarva and Philadelphia Folk Festivals. Jessica's music is part of WHYY's Local Music project, and she has appeared on WHYY's You Oughta Know. Her album “Wild River” was released in April 2022. The Old State House concert series is presented by Delaware Friends of Folk. These events are supported by a grant from the Kent County Fund for the Arts, an organization that aims to enhance the quality of life, educate, and broaden perspectives by supporting the arts and arts organizations in Kent County. Support is also provided by the First State National Heritage Park, a partnership of State and City agencies under the leadership of Delaware State Parks and the Delaware Division of Historical and Cultural Affairs. Delaware Friends of Folk are partially supported by a grant from the Delaware Division of the Arts, a state agency, in partnership with the National Endowment for the Arts. The Division promotes Delaware arts events on www.DelawareScene.com. Links: www.delfolk.org https://www.delfolk.org/state-house https://www.jessicagraae.com/home

Title: The American Revolution and the Fate of the World
FLEETWOOD MACKED – MATINEE
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: One of rock’s most successful hit-making machines Fleetwood Mac’s performance history comes to life with this visually and sonically uncanny tribute… Fleetwood Macked is a New York based Fleetwood Mac Tribute Band. Hailed as the most authentic Fleetwood Mac tribute band in the U.S., much of the realism comes from the bands history. Husband and wife musical team Hillary and Michael (Stevie and Lindsey ) and friends Cecile “Cc Keyz”, Jay and Phil (Christine, John and Mick), that have made great music together in various incarnations finally all came together with their mutual love of Fleetwood Mac. All the members of Fleetwood Macked are and have always been professional, touring Rock musicians, which also adds to the authenticity of the sound of the band. Fleetwood Macked live brings the passion, depth, heart and the musicianship Fleetwood Mac’s music requires. Whether performing the Rumours album in it’s entirety or a decades show featuring Fleetwood Mac’s hits from the 70’s, 80’s, 90’s and today, every performance transports audiences to another time and place. Complete with costume changes, dialogue and video backdrops it a show not to be missed.

Title: SHOWSTOPPERS: BROADWAY CABARET
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Step into the spotlight and experience an unforgettable evening of musical magic at the Milton Theatre! Showstoppers: Broadway Cabaret is a dazzling celebration of the greatest hits from Broadway’s most iconic shows. Featuring an all-star lineup of vocal talent, this cabaret-style performance will bring to life the songs that have stopped shows and captured hearts on stages from New York to the West End. From powerful ballads to high-energy ensemble numbers, this evening promises to deliver all the drama, passion, and spectacle that make Broadway unforgettable. Whether you’re a lifelong theatre fan or just looking for a night of outstanding entertainment, Showstoppers is guaranteed to leave you singing along and applauding for more!

Title: AMISH OUTLAWS
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Featured as a “Top Entertainment Pick” in New York Magazine’s 2012 “In a very short time, this band has captured the hearts, minds, and butter churners of the masses with their hilarious onstage performances of everything from Bon Jovi to Snoop & Dre.” – Night & Day Magazine It is a little-known fact that most Amish practice a tradition similar to the Christian “Confirmation” and Jewish “Bar Mitzvah” called “Rumspringa” (literal translation: “running around”) in which Amish children at the age of 16 have an opportunity to live free of the strict Amish code of conduct before deciding if they want to come back and be baptized into the Amish church. Surprisingly, virtually all of the youths return. But sometimes they don’t. Four out of the original six members of The Amish Outlaws were born and raised in Lancaster, PA and had a strict Amish upbringing. No electricity from land lines, no alcohol, no musical instruments, but their spirits were too wild for the Amish lifestyle. Once they trampled in the Devil’s Playground, there was no turning back. In the years since Rumspringa, the members of the Amish Outlaws have become very well acclimated to the pleasures and vices of the modern world… music, most of all. Thus, with a bold lust for life and a fire for music and performance that can only come from 16 years of repression, The Amish Outlaws were unleashed upon the world.

Title: KICK IT OUT: A TRIBUTE TO HEART
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Passionately performing Heart’s greatest music with integrity, power, and adrenaline. For those eager to “keep the love alive”, Kick It Out is sure to leave you with a goosebump moment with their moving re-creation of Heart’s music! Kick It Out A Tribute To Heart band was formed in 2009 and is based in the Philadelphia, PA/South Jersey area. Born out of a sincere respect, admiration, and love of HEART and the timeless music written by Ann and Nancy Wilson. Rock & Roll Hall of fame inductees, HEART was formed by two sisters from Seattle, Ann and Nancy Wilson. They rose to fame in the 1970’s with songs like Magic Man, Crazy On You, Barracuda and Dog and Butterfly. Their success continued through the 80s and 90s with power ballads like Alone, What About Love and These Dreams. To date, they have sold over 30 million albums worldwide and continue to tour each year. Kick It Out is a collection of seasoned, accomplished musicians and performers with national and international experience who have had a strong presence in the tri-state area for many years.

Title: LEZ ZEPPELIN – ALL GIRLS! ALL ZEPPELIN!
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Founded in 2004 by New York guitarist, Steph Paynes, the all-girl quartet, LEZ ZEPPELIN, has since gained unanimous critical acclaim as one of the most exciting live acts around, becoming the first female rock act to pay homage to Led Zeppelin and to garner rave reviews across the board. LEZ ZEPPELIN stays true to the musically audacious spirit of the original, delivering the legendary rock band’s blistering arrangements and monstrous sound note-for-note at sold-out frenzied shows around the world. Jimmy Page said “They played the Led Zeppelin music with an extraordinary sensuality and an energy and passion that highlighted their superb musicianship.” The thing that sets LEZ ZEPPELIN apart is the seamless and unique way they inject their gender-bending performance into the original material. Since Lez Zeppelin’s formation, the group has broken both glass and class ceilings. Whether it’s playing on catwalk above Times Square for 40,000, or on the main stage at Bonnaroo, Hellfest and the Isle of Wight; flying to India for a benefit concert for ambulances or taking the stage – twice! — at Madison Square Garden, it’s clear that the unique power, personality and magical force of Lez Zeppelin is far beyond that of a “tribute” act. SPIN Magazine called them “the most powerful all-female band in rock history.” For those sceptics who still dare to ask: Can four women pull off the exuberant, powerful and musically intricate performances for which Led Zeppelin are known, a LEZ ZEPPELIN show is nothing short of a revelation.

Title: ALEX SHILLO’S & BADLANDS: TRIBUTE TO BRUCE SPINGSTEEN
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Get ready for an electric, high-energy night celebrating the iconic sound of Bruce Springsteen! Fronted by multi-instrumentalist and singer-songwriter Alex Shillo, this is more than just a tribute—it’s an authentic, soul-stirring homage to “The Boss.” Joined by Badlands, a powerhouse band featuring elite musicians who have shared stages with legends like Clarence Clemons, Aretha Franklin, and The Temptations, Shillo delivers spot-on vocal harmonies, soaring instrumentation, and undeniable rock-and-roll energy. Alex Shillo is a multi-instrumentalist/singer/songwriter. One of Alex’s many influences is The Boss. While Alex is currently in the Studio working on his solo/original music (Which you’re all gonna love) he will be playing some Northeast dates with his band Badlands. He’s not an impersonator, he’s a talented musician that loves playing Bruce’s great music, and will also be showcasing 1 or 2 of his own original songs. In addition, Alex’s dad Carl Shillo is the founder/leader of the national act Silverado. In the late 70’s and early 80’s Silverado was signed to CBS records, had songs on the Billboard charts, toured the world with Steppenwolf and a bunch others. Recently Silverado (With Alex on Rhythm Guitar and support Vocals) toured up and down the East Coast opening for major acts like Big & Rich, Jerrod Niemann, and many others with Silverado. In Badlands Alex is backed by some of the areas top-notch musicians from Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island who have performed with artists such as Clarence Clemons of Bruce Springsteen’s E Street Band, Aretha Franklin, The Four Tops, The Temptations, Johnny Mathis, Gloria Gaynor, and John Cafferty to name a few. Their ability to capture the essence of “The Boss’ both with their spot-on vocal harmonies and advanced instrumental abilities makes them the top choice to perform the music of Bruce Springsteen.

The members of Parrotbeach hail from across our great nation, giving their sound a variation of musical influences. From Florida to Virginia, Hawaii to N.YC. Parrotbeach has the feel.

Title: XTREME QUEEN: THE LEGACY OF FREDDIE MERCURY – MATINEE
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Xtreme Queen is the only Queen Tribute Band that reproduces in full detail, the legendary 1985 LIVE AID performance as part of every concert! ​Xtreme Queen has ONE VISION (pun intended!) Their goal is to replicate the original Queen band in its entirety. Unlike other tribute bands, XQ reproduces as close to the original album versions of every Queen song, as audiences remember hearing on their original vinyl records over 40 years ago! This combined with authentic costumes, synchronized videos of Freddie Mercury, and the bands RENOWNED LIVE AID 1985 Recreation, this is more than a band… it is a theatrical tribute “X”perience! A high-energy Queen cover band based in New York, this group of seasoned, multi-talented musicians is the closest experience to a real Queen show since the passing of Freddie Mercury. Thrilling the audience with electrifying guitar solos, addictive riffs, and legendary lyrics, the music of Queen has mesmerized fans for decades. Lead guitarist Sal L. has been shredding, composing, and educating for over three decades. He is a classically trained guitarist, that has opened for national acts such as ZZ Top and Jeff Beck. Bassist, James L. has studied with bass players for headline names such as Paul Simon, Cyndi Lauper and Herby Hancock. Dave W. as Roger Taylor, has opened for well known acts such as White Lion, Skidrow, Obsession and EZO. Xtreme Queen’s front-man, S Thomas, as Freddie Mercury, has been a professional Tribute Artist for over 10 years. He has been featured on Good Morning America, VH1, MTV and several other prime time networks. His showmanship authentically replicates all the signature moves, charisma, impression and energy of Freddie Mercury himself.

Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: ENCORE Performance after Sold Out Shows Three Years in a Row! “Ultimate Diamond” is a high-energy band that pays tribute to the iconic music of Neil Diamond. “Ultimate Diamond” is a high energy band based out of Delaware that pays tribute to the iconic music of Neil Diamond. The fun and interactive show reflects the band’s deep friendship with each other and their absolute joy for performing live. There is no “impersonating” going on at an “Ultimate Diamond” show. However, lead singer and Delaware Rock n Roll Society Hall of Famer Sol Knopf captures the essence of Neil’s voice with uncanny similarity. The band is as talented as they come and the show emotes laughter, joy and tears…all leading to an experience you will never forget. We hope you will join us for this wonderful celebration of Neil Diamond’s music. Ultimate Diamond is Delaware’s premier Neil Diamond tribute band—an electrifying ensemble that brings the legendary artist’s music to life with heart, precision, and style. Each performance captures the warmth, energy, and emotional storytelling that made Neil Diamond an icon. Blending impeccable musicianship with authentic showmanship, Ultimate Diamond delivers an experience that resonates with audiences of all ages and celebrates the enduring power of live music.

Title: KISS THE SKY: JIMI HENDRIX TRIBUTE
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: The WORLD’S GREATEST JIMI HENDRIX TRIBUTE has arrived! Delivering the most historically accurate re-creations of Hendrix’s iconic concerts and live performances ever produced, a KTS show is a musical time machine made for audiences of today to get RE-EXPERIENCED! THE PERFORMERS… KISS THE SKY is led by virtuoso guitarist and former Columbia recording artist, Jimy Bleu who is the last surviving protege’ of Hendrix himself and the longest running Hendrix tribute specialist in the world at over 50 years playing Jimi since meeting him in 1968. The band is composed of world-class musicians from the NYC metro area who have played with legends like Aretha Franklin, Ms. Lauryn Hill, Teddy Pendergrass, Living Colour, Lady Gaga, Wilson Pickett, Russell Simmons, J. Geils, James Cotton, John Mayall and more. KTS performers are so experienced that each of Hendrix’s remaining former bandmates—Billy Cox, Juma Sultan, and Gerry Velez—have all performed on stage with KISS THE SKY, incluuding at their 55th Woodstock Anniversary Reunion show which was covered by Guitar World Magazine: https://www.guitarworld.com/news/jimi-hendrix-woodstock-bandmates-reunite-for-the-first-time-in-40-years-for-hendrix-tribute Historic!! The ONLY Hendrix tribute that can accurately re-create four of Hendrix’s most iconic concerts: 1967 – The Experience @Monterey Pop 1969 – Band of Gypsys @ The Fillmore 1969 – Sun & Rainbows @Woodstock 1970 – Cry of Love @ Isle of Wight AND MORE… Just like Jimi Hendrix, Jimy Bleu is a left-handed talent, able to play the guitar over his head, behind his back, and even with his teeth! KISS THE SKY brings Jimi’s legacy to life, delivering the closest re-creation possible of what it was like to see Hendrix in his prime. Hits like FIRE, HEY JOE, FOXY LADY, VOODOO CHILD, PURPLE HAZE, LITTLE WING and more come alive on stage! A RE-EXPERIENCE is happening!

Title: DELAWARE COMEDY THEATRE: ADULT IMPROV COMEDY
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Get ready for another evening of rolling good fun with irreverent improv adult comedy that is based on audience suggestion in the style of “Whose Line Is It Anyway?”! You can play an active part on this interactive comedy as the historic Milton Theatre presents the Delaware Comedy Theatre. Make sure you come with the spirit of spontaneity as you might just find yourself on stage with the cast! Delaware Comedy Theatre (DCT) in partnership with the historic Milton Theatre is proud to present a very special show to mark their 21st Anniversary: “TEAM PLAY IMPROV,” an all-new competitive improvisational comedy show in which the members of Delaware Comedy Theatre will play special guests Fearless Improv (of Wilmington, Delaware) in a no holds barred comedy showdown and improvised throwdown. The winner – out of four rounds of completely improvised scenes judged by the audience – will take home bragging rights and the coveted Krab Kup, an iconic prize of the Team Play Improv format! “Best of all,” says David Warick, Artistic Director of Delaware Comedy Theatre, “both teams are donating their take of the house, after costs, to an amazing first responder’s charity – the Tunnel to Towers Foundation, in order to honor the anniversary of 9/11 and give to an amazing organization!” Information about the Tunnel to Towers can be found at https://www.t2t.org Delaware Comedy Theatre is a non-profit performing and educational organization presenting completely improvised comedy in the style of Whose Line Is It Anyway and Upright CitizensBrigade. Every show is unique and different according to the audience in attendance. This show is for adult audiences only, as mature humor is always a part of improvisational theatre. "We look forward to filling the house to raise money for this fantastic organization. And we know the audience is going to love watching DCT and Fearless go head-to-head for all the laughs this September!", Warick adds.

Title: LOWER CASE BLUES
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: New fusion of old blues, funk, and rock! Lower Case Blues isn’t your grandfather’s blues band. Delaware Hall of Fame inductees and relentless road warriors, this powerhouse trio fuses traditional blues, heavy funk, and explosive rock ’n’ roll into a high-energy, improvisational groove. Having shared stages with legends like Buddy Guy, Kenny Wayne Shepherd, and Blues Traveler, LCB brings a fresh, unpredictable, and soul-drenching sound to every stage they hit. Catch them live and take it for a ride! Lower Case Blues is a Blues/Jam trio hailing from the eastern shore and has been together since 2003. Founding members Jake Banaszak (Guitar) and BJ Muntz (Bass/Vocals) play and original blues style that is based on traditional blues, but expands into an organic and very improvisational sound that is uniquely their own. Having recorded several albums and gigging relentlessly over the years, the band has earned a reputation of being one of the hardest working bands in the land. High-voltage, unpredictable, and packed with soul—Lower Case Blues has been tearing up the East Coast music scene for over two decades. Featuring Jake Banaszak’s blistering guitar riffs, B.J. Muntz’s deep, slap-bass grooves and soulful vocals, and Tristan Gilbert’s thunderous pocket drumming, this trio delivers a unique blend of greasy blues, funk swagger, and jam-band spontaneity. Loved by locals and tour veterans alike, Lower Case Blues turns every show into an unforgettable, jam-packed live experience.

Title: Owl Howl
Description: Many people have heard the haunting call of an owl, but few have ever been lucky enough to spot one in the wild. Mt. Cuba’s diverse landscapes, mature trees, and rolling topography provide the absolute perfect habitat for three of Delaware’s spectacular native species: the Barred, Great Horned, and Eastern Screech owl. Because winter is peak roosting season, this is your best chance of the year to glimpse these majestic birds of prey. You will get a rare opportunity to explore Mt. Cuba’s stunning landscapes under the cover of twilight and darkness. Equipped with provided flashlights and binoculars and guided by experts, you can expect: Expert Instruction: Begin with a brief, fascinating look into the secretive lives, silent flight adaptations, and behaviors of local owls. Title: Pre-Raphaelite Powerhouse: The Bancroft Bequest
Description: How did one of the most important collections of British Pre-Raphaelite art outside the United Kingdom come to Wilmington, Delaware? Pre-Raphaelite Powerhouse: The Bancroft Bequest traces the remarkable history of Samuel Bancroft Jr. (1840–1915), a Wilmington textile manufacturer whose encounter with the art of Dante Gabriel Rossetti in 1880 ignited a lifelong passion for the Pre-Raphaelite movement. Bancroft’s collection began with admiration and quickly became a pursuit. Drawn to the movement’s intense color, literary imagination, symbolic richness, and devotion to “truth to nature,” he assembled an extraordinary group of artworks by Rossetti, Edward Burne-Jones, William Morris, Ford Madox Brown, Elizabeth Siddal, and their circle. More than a collector of beautiful objects, Bancroft sought proximity to the artists themselves, gathering works and archival materials that brought him into contact with the creative networks that shaped Pre-Raphaelitism. Bringing together masterworks, archival documents, and rarely seen material, Pre-Raphaelite Powerhouse explores how private passion became public legacy. It reveals the Bancroft Bequest not only as a treasure of Victorian art, but as a defining act of cultural stewardship—one that has made Delaware Art Museum an essential destination for the study and enjoyment of the Pre-Raphaelites.

Title: Elizabeth Colomba: More than a Muse
Description: More than a Muse draws together a selection of works by Elizabeth Colomba that reflect on female figures portrayed throughout masterpieces of Western Art. Each hinge on a central query: who are these women? Too often unnamed and subordinated to the legacies of the predominantly male artists they inspired, these women were not merely muses; they were persons in their own right, with their own stories. Through her paintings and their studies on paper, Colomba returns agency and complexity to figures oft used only as symbols. With these portraits, she examines lives that were, in her words, “rich, complicated, and full beyond what the canvas could contain.” Colomba does not try to complete their stories, but rather, to open them. Jeanne Duval, Margaret Garner, Olga Brown, Fanny Eaton. Colomba draws out the lives of these and other women in her works as an invitation to consider, to question, to admire, and to learn. While we know intimate details about the mainly male painters and writers across the artistic canon—the names of Édouard Manet, Charles Baudelaire, or Edgar Degas have hardly been overlooked—the biographies, lives, and achievements of the women who inspired them remain largely unknown and under-researched. Title: Simeon Solomon: Queer and Jewish in Victorian London
Description: Simeon Solomon: Queer and Jewish in Victorian London is the first major museum exhibition in the United States devoted to Simeon Solomon (1840–1905), one of the most daring and distinctive artists associated with the Pre-Raphaelites. Described by Edward Burne-Jones as “the greatest of us all,” Solomon used his artistic practice to explore his sexuality and faith. He produced art that brought biblical narrative, religious ritual, and queer sensuality into unexpected dialogue. Assembling over 180 paintings, watercolors, drawings, prints, photographs, and archival material, Simeon Solomon: Queer and Jewish in Victorian London follows Solomon’s vision across Jewish, Christian, and Greco-Roman subjects. These works range from Old Testament scenes to depictions of Sappho, Bacchus, and other classical figures—subjects through which Solomon gave form to beauty, longing, and same-sex passion. Solomon’s career never recovered after his 1873 arrest for attempted sodomy. Rejected by the art establishment in which he had once thrived, he lived for decades under precarious circumstances marked by alcoholism, homelessness, and repeated stays in London workhouses. Yet Solomon did not disappear. He continued to produce an extensive body of work and garnered a new generation of followers and supporters, even as later histories of Victorian art minimized his achievements or omitted…

Description: Titanic The Musical tells the powerful true story of the RMS Titanic’s ill-fated maiden voyage, following passengers and crew across all classes as they set sail with hope and ambition. As dreams collide with tragedy, the sweeping score and interwoven stories capture both the grandeur of the ship and the humanity of those aboard.

Title: THE BODYGUARD
Description: THE INTERNATIONAL, AWARD-WINNING SMASH-HIT MUSICAL THE BODYGUARD IS BACK! Based on the 1992 film starring Whitney Houston and Kevin Costner, THE BODYGUARD is a thrilling, romantic musical that combines high-stakes suspense with unforgettable music. Former Secret Service agent turned bodyguard, Frank Farmer, is hired to protect superstar Rachel Marron from an unknown stalker. Both expect to be in charge of their situation - what they don’t expect is to fall in love. A “BRILLIANT” (The Times), breathtakingly romantic thriller, THE BODYGUARD features a whole host of unforgettable classics including “Queen of the Night,” “So Emotional,” “I Will Always Love You,” “I Wanna Dance with Somebody,” "Saving All My Love," and "One Moment in Time", alongside thrilling plot twists and emotional drama. THE BODYGUARD is an electrifying combination of romance, suspense and chart-topping music that will captivate audiences from start to finish. Content Advisory This production has repetitive flashing lights and visual effects, pyrotechnics, smoke and haze, gunshots, loud sound effects and scenes of mild peril. Age Recommendation Recommended for ages 10+ Running Time 2 hours 10 minutes including a 20-minute intermission

Title: Historic Lewes First Friday Community Nights
Description: Experience a taste of what Historic Lewes has to offer our community on First Fridays! Each month from 4 p.m. to 7 p.m., visit the Sussex Tavern for a colonial-inspired beverage, stop into the Lewistown Coffee-house for a taste of the Revolution, browse the Historic Lewes Antique Shop, listen to live music, take a tour, and enjoy stories from bygone times…all in the beautiful setting of our Historic Lewes Town Campus. Our community nights are FREE to attend!
