Title: A Day in Old New Castle
Description: Annual event held the third Saturday in May. Experience life on the river: historical reenactments, plundering pirates, colonial craftsmen, music and performers, open museums, tours of rarely open homes and gardens, and deck tours of tall ships as available (included with ticket).

Title: WWII Encampment
Description: Individuals and groups from across Delmarva representing units of the US Army, Air Forces and Women's services converge at the Air Mobility Command Museum to celebrate the heritage of the U.S. military during WWII. The encampment area consists of period vehicles, squad tents, historical displays and the equipment of airmen and the ground troops they supported. All reenactors represent a unit related to an aircraft or exhibit at the AMC Museum. Visitors can interact with exhibits, watch reenactor demonstrations and have their photos taken in period vehicles. The encampment coincides with the AMCM Open Cockpit Day on 17 May.

Title: Hair
Organization: DelawareScene (Div. of the Arts events portal)
Description: Hair: The American Tribal Love-Rock Musical is a vibrant, rebellious celebration of the 1960s counterculture. Following a group of young people navigating love, identity, and resistance during the Vietnam War era, it blends rock music, bold storytelling, and raw emotion. Energetic, provocative, and heartfelt, it captures a generation’s fight for freedom and self-expression

Title: Genealogist in Residence
Description: Gather your materials, gather your thoughts, and come see us on the first Saturday of each month with the exception of January from 10:00 AM. to 1:00 P.M. for the Genealogist in Residence Program. Members of the Sussex County Genealogical Society, including Historic Lewes member and volunteer Iris Fisher, will be available to help anyone that has a question about their family tree. The member-experts are seasoned searchers who come from different areas and are ready to help answer your questions regardless of what corner of the globe your quest may lead you! As an added benefit the Historic Lewes archives’ family files will be available for your use. The Genealogist in Residence program is sponsored by the Lewes Historical Society and the Sussex County Genealogical Society.

Title: La Cage aux Folles
Timezone: America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York; America/New_York
Description: RENEÉ G. O’LEARY FUNDRAISER music & lyric by Jerry Herman book by Harvey Fierstein based on the play by Jean Poiret directed by Brian M. Touchette asst. directed by Kathleen M. Mooney Step into the heart, humor, and glamour of ‘La Cage aux Folles’… the hit musical that inspired the beloved film The Birdcage. When Georges’ son brings his fiancée’s ultra-conservative parents home for dinner, Georges and Albin must balance love, laughter, and chaos to protect the family they’ve built. Filled with unforgettable songs, big energy, and touching moments, this celebration of acceptance is as timely as ever.

Description: @ Step inside Star Lab and journey through the cosmos without leaving Earth Star Lab programs are available as an add-on experience on Saturdays and Sundays at 10:30 a.m., 11:30 a.m. and 1:30 p.m. Tickets may be purchased at the museum’s front desk, or on the eSales calendar when purchasing advance admission. Prices below are in addition to general admission or membership. Purchase advance tickets for Star Lab on the eSales calendar Member Prices: Ages 3 & up $3, Toddler $1. Non-Member Pricing: Ages 3 & up $5, Toddler $2 . The Delaware Museum of Nature and Science’s immersive dome experience takes you on an unforgettable voyage through space. Inside this intimate, inflatable 360° planetarium, stunning visuals wrap around you as one of our expert Museum Educators guides you through the wonders of the universe. Each 30-45 minute program explores captivating astronomical or Earth science topics including our Solar System, the stories behind constellations, the lifecycle of stars, distant galaxies, and other cosmic phenomena. The dome’s enveloping projections create the sensation of floating through space, making complex scientific concepts accessible and exciting for visitors of all ages.
